 Vardhman (West Bengal)

... ..
 Versus
1 . The State of Bihar Bihar  2. Sujata Kumari @ Sujata Devi Wife of Banti Prasad @ Banty Prasad, D/o  Ranendra Narayan Singh Resident of village - Kharika, P.S. - Sonepur, D  - Saran at Chapra

Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Narendra Kumar  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Narsingh Tanti  ======================================================
 CORAM:
HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 2 18-07-2023 Heard the parties.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Section 341, 323, 34, 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. Petitioner, who is husband of opposite party no2., is said to have ousted the opposite party no.2 from her matrimonial home in association of his family members over the dowry demand.
4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is an innocent person and has committed no offence.
Petitioner has neither made any dowry demand nor drove her out of her matrimonial home nor tormented her over the demand of dowry.
He is still ready to keep her with full honour and dignity.

The petitioner has relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.36320 of 2023(2) dt.18-07-2023 Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @
Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar, reported in 2006 (3) PLJR 182.
